question: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) me parivar ko kitna swasthya beema milta hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — PM-JAY (Ayushman Bharat, 2018) me har parivar ko ₹5 lakh/varsh ka swasthya beema milta hai; yah duniya ki sabse badi swasthya beema yojana hai. | Galat kyun: ₹2 lakh, ₹3 lakh aur ₹10 lakh is yojana ki rashi nahi hain — ₹5 lakh hi nishchit cover hai. | Concept: Sarkari swasthya yojana — naam, varsh, rashi ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: PM-JAY 2018 — 5 lakh cover. | Source: notes/10_public_health.md §10.2.

question: ASHA ka pura naam kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — ASHA = Accredited Social Health Activist; gaon ki swasthya sahayika jo NHM ke tahat kaam karti hai. | Galat kyun: 'State Health Authority', 'Assistant Social Health Agent' aur 'Allied Social Health Assistant' ASHA ke galat vistar hain — ASHA me 'Accredited' aur 'Activist' dono shabd aate hain. | Concept: Swasthya karyakarta — pura naam. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: ASHA = gaon ki 'asha' (ummid) — swasthya sahayika. | Source: notes/10_public_health.md §10.2/§10.3.

question: Mission Indradhanush kis se sambandhit hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Mission Indradhanush (2014) bachon ke sampurna teekakaran (immunisation) ke liye hai. | Galat kyun: Poshan (Poshan Abhiyaan), Swachhta (Swachh Bharat) aur Jal suraksha (Jal Jeevan Mission) alag yojanayen hain. | Concept: Yojana ↔ uska lakshya. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Indradhanush ke 7 rang — shuruaat me 7 rogon ke khilaf teekakaran. | Source: notes/10_public_health.md §10.2.

question: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) kis ko badhava deti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — JSY (2005) sansthagat prasav (institutional delivery) ko badhava deti hai — garbhvati mahila ko aspatal me prasav ke liye protsahan aur sahayata milti hai; ASHA madad karti hai. | Galat kyun: Teekakaran (Mission Indradhanush), ghar par prasav (JSY iske vipreet hai) aur Poshan (Poshan Abhiyaan) JSY ka lakshya nahi hain. | Concept: Yojana ↔ lakshya; JSY ka lakshya matri aur shishu mrityu kam karna hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: JSY = Janani Suraksha = aspatal me surakshit prasav. | Source: notes/10_public_health.md §10.2.

question: BMI ka formula kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — BMI = Vajan (kg) / (Unchai m)²; Normal 18.5–24.9 hota hai. | Galat kyun: Vajan/Unchai (varg nahi) aur Vajan × Unchai galat sutra hain; Unchai/Vajan ulta hai. | Concept: BMI sharir ke vajan ka unchai ke hisab se map hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: BMI me unchai ka 'varg' (square) lagta hai — isiliye m². | Source: notes/10_public_health.md §10.3.

question: Bharat kab se polio-mukt hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — WHO ne March 2014 me Bharat ko polio-mukt ghoshit kiya (aakhri polio case January 2011 me mila tha); Pulse Polio karyakram se unmoolan hua. | Galat kyun: 2005, 2010 aur 2018 me Bharat polio-mukt ghoshit nahi hua tha. | Concept: Unmoolan ki ghoshna ka varsh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Polio-mukt 2014 — aakhri case 2011, ghoshna 2014. | Source: notes/10_public_health.md §10.2.

question: Malaria kis machhar se failta hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Malaria Plasmodium (protozoa) se hota hai aur Anopheles mada machhar se failta hai. | Galat kyun: Aedes dengue/chikungunya failata hai; Culex filariasis se juda hai; sandfly kala-azar failata hai. | Concept: Rog ↔ vahak (vector) ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Malaria = Anopheles; Dengue = Aedes. | Source: notes/10_public_health.md §10.1/§10.3.

question: Poshan Abhiyaan kab shuru hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Poshan Abhiyaan 2018 me kuposhan (malnutrition) ke khilaf shuru hua; Poshan Maah September me manaya jata hai. | Galat kyun: 2014 (Swachh Bharat/Mission Indradhanush), 2016 aur 2020 is yojana ke varsh nahi hain. | Concept: Yojana ↔ shuruaat ka varsh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Poshan Abhiyaan 2018 — PM-JAY ke saal hi. | Source: notes/10_public_health.md §10.2.

question: IMR ka matlab kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — IMR = Infant Mortality Rate: 1,000 jeevit janm par 1 varsh se kam umar me hone wali mrityu. | Galat kyun: 'Indian Medical Registry', 'Infectious Mortality Ratio' aur 'Infant Medicine Rate' IMR ke galat vistar hain. | Concept: Swasthya suchak — IMR, MMR, TFR. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: IMR me 'I' = Infant (shishu), 'M' = Mortality (mrityu). | Source: notes/10_public_health.md §10.3.

question: PHC ka pura naam kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — PHC = Primary Health Centre; gaon star ka pehla swasthya kendra (CHC usse bada hota hai). | Galat kyun: 'Private Health Clinic', 'Primary Hospital Centre' aur 'Public Health Centre' galat vistar hain — PHC sarkari, prathamik kendra hai. | Concept: Swasthya vyavastha ka star — PHC < CHC < jila aspatal. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: PHC = Primary (pehla) Health Centre. | Source: notes/10_public_health.md §10.3.

question: BCG tika kis rog ke liye hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — BCG tika TB ke liye janm par lagta hai. | Galat kyun: Hepatitis (Hepatitis B tika), Polio (OPV) aur Measles (khasra tika) ke liye alag tike hain. | Concept: Teekakaran schedule — tika ↔ rog. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: BCG = janm par, TB ke liye. | Source: notes/10_public_health.md §10.3.

question: Swachh Bharat Mission kab shuru hua?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Swachh Bharat Mission 2014 me shuru hua; lakshya ODF (khule me shauch se mukti) tha. | Galat kyun: 2015, 2016 aur 2018 is mission ke varsh nahi hain. | Concept: Yojana ↔ shuruaat ka varsh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: SBM 2014 — 2 October 2014 (Gandhi Jayanti) ko shuru hua. | Source: notes/10_public_health.md §10.2.

question: Jal Jeevan Mission ka lakshya kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Jal Jeevan Mission (2019) ka lakshya Har Ghar Jal — har ghar me nal se jal pahunchana hai. | Galat kyun: Har Ghar Bijli (bijli yojana), Har Ghar Shauchalaya (Swachh Bharat) aur Har Ghar Ration (khadyanna) is mission ke lakshya nahi hain. | Concept: Yojana ↔ lakshya; 'Jal' shabd hi lakshya batata hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Jal Jeevan = Jal (pani) — nal se jal. | Source: notes/10_public_health.md §10.2.

question: Rajasthan me muft dava yojana ka naam kya hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Rajasthan me Mukhyamantri Nishulk Dava Yojana (muft dava) hai; iske saath Nishulk Jaanch Yojana (muft test) bhi hai. | Galat kyun: Ayushman Bharat kendra ki beema yojana hai; Poshan Abhiyaan kuposhan ki yojana hai; JSY prasav ki yojana hai — inme se koi Rajasthan ki muft dava yojana nahi hai. | Concept: Rajya yojana ↔ kendra yojana me antar. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Nishulk Dava = Rajasthan ki muft dava. | Source: notes/10_public_health.md §10.3.
